data.title: Gas price increase for tariff "Muster Gas Komfort" effective 1 November 2026
data.summary: Muster Gas GmbH informs the customer that, from 1 November 2026, the working price for the "Muster Gas Komfort" gas tariff rises from 10.94 to 12.36 ct/kWh and the monthly advance payment (Abschlag) rises from €96.00 to €109.00; the base price stays at €14.50/month.
data.explanation: Your gas supplier is raising the per-kWh price and your monthly advance payment starting 1 November 2026. Because this is a price increase, you have a special right to cancel the contract without the usual notice period, effective from the date the new price takes hold — the app will show you until when you can use this right. If you do nothing, the contract continues automatically at the new, higher price and the higher monthly amount will be collected. Check whether cheaper tariffs are available before deciding.

items.title: Monthly gas advance payment (Abschlag)
items.action: Continue paying the monthly advance payment, which will increase to the new amount from November 2026 unless you cancel.
items.consequence: If unpaid, the supplier may charge default interest or reminder fees under standard terms.
